body:
Firstly, some introduction. While I by no means consider myself an expert, I am however experienced enough with many drugs, both psychedelic and otherwise including LSA, MDMA, aMT, 5-Meo-Dalt, a lot of Cannabis, psilocybin mushrooms, syrian rue and several stimulants, depressants and dissociatives. I mention this to give a background as to what I am comparing my experience to. I was on no medication and had been drug free for the week preceding.
T=00: 100mg bk-2C-B weighed on a sensitive scale and ingested in a gel capsule (washed down with orange juice to avoid dimerisation in non-acidic solution) at approx. 21.30. Perfect mindset prior to ingestion and very excited and curious as to where this substance will take me.
T+30: Head downstairs to eat a nutella sandwich and begin feeling a tingle in my scalp, euphoria and some spaced out thoughts.
T+45: I sit down to watch a film, The Kingdom of Heaven, with my father. Scalp tingling intensifying and pleasant cold sensation all over my skin.
T+1.00: Cinematography is beautiful as are the effects and colours of the film. No anxiety and feeling incredible! The positions of objects and shapes become more interesting to me. Currently a ++.
T+1.30: Head outside into the cool night air and begin noticing some serious visual distortions such as geometry in leaves/trees, on a pebbled wall and generally scattered within the darkness. Definitely at a +++. Still feeling like Im in heaven. Possibly my favourite come up Ive ever experienced.
T+2.00: Room becomes brighter and I can tell my pupils are big without even looking at them (confirmed plates in mirror). Very psychedelic headspace.
T+2.30: Euphoria just keeps intensifying and comes in waves of transcendental pleasure.
T+3.00: Movie ends and I return upstairs to notice the effects still coming on with absolutely zero anxiety. Geometry and patterns in carpet prominent and waves or radiation coming from parallel lines and angles (my favourite sign Im tripping). My resting HR is at 72bpm, fast enough for me but obviously still low.
T+3.30: Intense pleasure from music and definite CEV geometry (I draw a small vision I have, spirals and chevrons etc. similar to paleolithic art my ancestors likely drew, and find it extremely pleasant to express creativity while in an altered state of consciousness.
T+4.00: Retrospective/deep thinking Wikipedia session eg. Evolution/psychedelics/life/introspection etc. I am surprised to have this on bk-2C-B as most reports said it didnt bring on this. Probably peaking.
T+5.00: Back downstairs for more food (incredibly delicious). Outside air is crisp and the tingles feel like electric pulses of joy rushing through my veins and out through the hairs standing on end all over my body.
T+6.00: Listen to some more music etc. Still tripping balls. I confirm this as my favourite chemical and I have certainly nailed the dose.
T+7.00: Attempt to sleep w/o etizolam. Experience a lot of CEVs through music.
T+7.30: Probably fall asleep around this time.
Woke up at +12.00 and took 1mg etizolam and got back to sleep. Still euphoric and high but no psychedelia.
After glow continuing now into T+21.00.
Overall, my best experience yet. I felt zero negatives whatsoever and felt it was a beautifully balanced substance. Entactogenic, entheogenic, psychedelic and empathogenic. I think this was in part to due my set and setting, the socialisation with my father and that I nailed the dose. I will certainly be trying this again!
